Their borrowed appearances had blurred in the bathhouse heat, and the return desk had charged them under unfamiliar terms. A basket of unsold violets stood beside the complaints. Fei had moved her scales upstairs, leaving a chalk arrow and a request that visitors carry the bags by their handles.

city_perfumer_workroom.speaker: fei_nuo
city_perfumer_workroom.text: Please put the bags beside the blue tray. Appearance stabilizer belongs on this shelf; dispatch wax belongs on the other. People keep blaming the perfume because both smell pleasant when cold. Scent helps a voluntarily fitted outward likeness hold its pattern, including a licensed voice timbre. It carries none of the wearer's memories. I made the wax for sealing delivery cords. Before we discuss the charges, I need to find out which material is actually present on these offered fragments.

city_perfumer_complaints.speaker: narrator
city_perfumer_complaints.text: The bathhouse cashier brought out the workers' copied complaints. One washer, after twenty years at the same boilers, rented a licensed performance face for evening market work. Its fitting receipt described temporary recognition use. Her family still knew her unchanged name; the new bill treated the rental as permanent-name-proof collateral. She had supplied a cut sleeve lining and its return tag for examination, keeping the mask herself. Another worker described a similar charge. Both wanted the records corrected without turning the bathhouse into a public identification booth.

city_perfumer_moth_arrival.speaker: narrator
city_perfumer_moth_arrival.text: A glass-winged spirit unfolded above the drying rack when Fei opened the upper shutter. It was the workroom's other tenant, tending spring cocoons in the silk loft and repairing torn thread for the weavers. Fei paid its share of the roof rent in nectar and clear storage space. The Glasswing Moth examined the covered trays before approaching. One sharp-smelling jar made it retreat toward the window. Lin Yue closed that lid, and the creature returned to ask how long these tests would take.

city_perfumer_moth_terms.speaker: glasswing_moth
city_perfumer_moth_terms.text: I can compare the surfaces you have offered. Warmed ink, dried resin, and scents trapped in cloth each reach me differently. They tell me about those materials, never a person's hidden face or intentions. Leave the sealed tags under glass and bring me the permitted cut fragments. The loft is reserved for cocoons tonight; I will help until the shadows reach that beam. Fei owes me a clean corner afterward, and I expect her to keep it. Your hearing cannot borrow the whole evening.

city_perfumer_materials.speaker: fei_nuo
city_perfumer_materials.text: This first jar holds plain amber wax from the same resin supplier. The second is my retained amber-violet return blend, prepared for the exchange return desk's spring consignment. Those will be our two controls. The workers' fragments make the comparison, and this unopened stabilizer will tell us whether a failing appearance has confused the complaint. My supply book records the dispatch blend separately from fitting perfume. Its delivery falls after the fitting dates printed on the offered tags. Keep the pages beside the jars.

city_perfumer_controls.speaker: lin_yue
city_perfumer_controls.text: I will mark the trays by number before anyone smells them. We can copy the key afterward. The offered fragments remain separate, with the workers' permission slips alongside them. For the appearance test, use this unworn practice tile: its reflected lattice gives us lines to measure without borrowing anybody's face. Apply fresh stabilizer to one half and stabilizer with the smallest permitted wax scraping to the other. The original tags stay dry. If heat damages a trial, we lose a trial strip and preserve the evidence.

city_perfumer_steam.speaker: narrator
city_perfumer_steam.text: The cashier lent them an empty warming niche after moving the clean towels. Fei set the controls and offered fragments above a covered bowl, bringing each to the same gentle warmth. The plain amber control released a resin smell. The retained blend and both fragments added the same dry violet note. On the practice tile, the contaminated half puckered while the clean lattice stayed even. Shen Qing copied the observation before the bowl cooled. None of the workers' masks entered the niche, and both original tags remained beneath glass.

city_perfumer_separation.speaker: fei_nuo
city_perfumer_separation.text: The return wax softens sooner than the appearance film. A trace caught in the lining can wrinkle that film in steam; it explains the defect we reproduced on the unworn tile. It cannot explain a change to a rental contract. We should keep those questions on separate lines in the report. I can clean a test lining and show the worker a repair estimate. For the charge, we need the return desk's papers and the maker's retained terms. A successful cleaning would leave that dispute entirely open.

city_perfumer_deadline.speaker: shen_qing
city_perfumer_deadline.text: The clerk receives exhibits before the evening shutters close. The other teams will report independently. Fei has fuel for one kettle, two already charged warming cups and two clean test sheets. Each cup's stone has a separate finite charge. The drying bay is available until the Moth needs it. We can compare the wax while preserving half the controls for a repeat. Choose a method whose heat source and stopping point another tester can identify, rather than spending the reference to produce a brighter result.

city_perfumer_choice.speaker: lin_yue
city_perfumer_choice.text: We need a repeatable comparison. I can give the rated warming cups a small control pulse; their recorded stone charges provide the heat. Or willing neighboring tenants can compare coded trays during a bounded interruption of work. Or we can spread thin strips in the vacant bay and use ordinary air. All use the same controls and offered fragments. The cup method saves kettle fuel by spending a different finite source, not by making my reserve a furnace.

choices.text: Warm paired samples with a measured qi pulse.
Invite willing workshop tenants to compare the coded trays.
Use the vacant loom bay for a slow strip comparison.

city_perfumer_qi_pulse.speaker: narrator
city_perfumer_qi_pulse.text: Fei checked the charged cups and rated control socket. Lin Yue sent one stopped quarter-unit command through her arm pair, then discharged; the two stones supplied the warmth. Fei used ordinary controls and water marks to keep the cups equal. The Moth made one permitted approach to each tray. When Lin Yue's hand trembled, she took no further command turn. Fei closed the cups at the recorded thermometer endpoint and checked their remaining charges. No sample was heated by qi transferred from Lin Yue's body.

city_perfumer_qi_source.speaker: fei_nuo
city_perfumer_qi_source.text: The answer repeats. Plain amber lacks the violet finish. My retained return blend and both offered fragments share it, while fresh fitting stabilizer behaves differently. Here are two comparison strips under their tray numbers. Attach the key and warming readings. The sealed tags supply permitted fitting dates, not a tested wax location or application time. My supply entry dates the blend's delivery; the courier's record must corroborate it. I can identify a material match within this test. I cannot identify the hand that applied it.

city_perfumer_qi_cost.speaker: lin_yue
city_perfumer_qi_cost.text: I need water and a quiet seat before carrying anything. Record the command pulse, its delivery loss and both cups' consumed charge. We saved kettle fuel by using charged cups; we did not get free heat. Keep the rest for the agreed repeat comparison. While I rest, I can copy your offered delivery entry. The original remains with you. Another tester may use ordinary warmth at the recorded endpoint without needing my arm route or reopening anyone's mask.

city_perfumer_trust_compare.speaker: narrator
city_perfumer_trust_compare.text: The neighboring tenants agreed to one comparison during their meal break. A dyer wanted her unfinished thread kept away from the wax; a reed worker asked for clean cups and a written temperature. Fei supplied both before uncovering the trays. Each tenant received the numbered controls and offered fragments in a different order, then wrote observations alone. Their notes returned with crumbs of lunch on the corners. Neither knew which jar Fei hoped would match. The dyer added that strong fragrance sometimes concealed poor resin.

city_perfumer_trust_reading.speaker: mo_ran
city_perfumer_trust_reading.text: Both notes group the offered fragments with the retained amber-violet return blend. Both put plain amber apart. The dyer noticed the violet finish sooner; the reed worker described it as dry flowers after the resin warmed. Their wording differs, but their numbered groups agree. We should keep the differences on the page. If a clerk reads only the convenient sentence, our careful comparison becomes another borrowed authority. Fei, open the tray key now, where everyone can compare the groups against the original labels.

city_perfumer_trust_cost.speaker: fei_nuo
city_perfumer_trust_cost.text: Their interrupted work costs more than a friendly thank-you. I will pay the agreed break fee from this delivery account and bring fresh cups tomorrow. The dyer can keep the cleaned spare lining as a repair example; it carries no face pattern. We retain two numbered strips, the observation notes, and this copy of my supply entry. My amber-violet stock went to the exchange return desk after the offered fitting dates. A courier's independent consignment sheet should check that sequence before the hearing treats it as established.

city_perfumer_drying_bay.speaker: narrator
city_perfumer_drying_bay.text: The Glasswing Moth offered the vacant bay until the shadows reached its marked beam. Shen Qing swept the floor while Fei stretched thin comparison strips on separate pegs. Plain amber, the retained amber-violet blend, fresh stabilizer, and the two offered fragments each received a numbered space. Lin Yue copied the arrangement onto the waiting-room notice. A weaver whose order needed drying chose the lower rack instead, after Fei paid the additional handling fee. The air moved slowly enough that they had time to watch it.

city_perfumer_drying_observation.speaker: glasswing_moth
city_perfumer_drying_observation.text: The two offered fragments carry the dry violet finish found on your retained return blend. The plain amber strip carries resin alone. Fresh fitting stabilizer has another trail, faint and greener. I have compared what is on these pegs; I have followed no wearer. Mark that distinction beside my observation. Now take the numbered strips down in order and cover the reference jars. The shadow has reached the beam. My cocoons need this dry bay tonight, and their work will continue after your papers leave.

city_perfumer_drying_cost.speaker: shen_qing
city_perfumer_drying_cost.text: The delayed order will leave on the next market cart. Fei has written the handling payment and told its buyer before closing the rack. I have copied the strip positions, drying time, and the Moth's stated limit. We can take two preserved comparison strips and a copy of the supply entry to the clerk; the remaining reference stock stays here for another test. Give me the broom again. Returning the bay clean is part of finishing this method, and the cocoons are already waiting by the shutter.

city_perfumer_return.speaker: narrator
city_perfumer_return.text: On the worktable, Fei assembled the numbered strips, copied supply entry, and signed observation note. The original offered tags stayed in their individual covers. She cleaned a spare lining and repeated the lattice trial: without the foreign wax trace, fresh stabilizer held evenly in gentle warmth. The repair addressed a material failure, leaving the collateral charge untouched. Lin Yue wrote both results below the same heading. Beside them, Fei placed the two retained control jars and reserved half their stock for a later comparison.

city_perfumer_blind_labels.speaker: glasswing_moth
city_perfumer_blind_labels.text: Read my numbered observation before you pack the cooled strips. Plain amber stood apart; my record grouped the original violet blend with the two offered fragments. Compare that written grouping with the tray key and retain any disagreement. It records the comparison I completed during my agreed turn. I decline a further cooled test; keep that limit beside my account. Leave the sealed tags covered. Fei, the sharp jar stays shut when I return to the loft. I still need to mend that tenant's torn thread.

city_perfumer_worker_story.speaker: mo_ran
city_perfumer_worker_story.text: The washer asked whether fixing her lining would make the new charge disappear. I told her the repair and the bill needed different answers. She wants the performance mask for next week's market; her grown daughter has already sewn its ribbons. She also wants the recognition credit returned under the temporary rental she signed. We can carry those requests together without claiming she sold a permanent identity. Give her this copied observation and the cleaning estimate. She should have something usable tonight while the hearing examines the batch.

city_perfumer_custody.speaker: elder_yun
city_perfumer_custody.text: The permission slips allow these fragments and copies to be shown at the hearing. The workers keep their masks, and the sealed original tags will be returned afterward. I have numbered each cover and asked the clerk to record who receives it. Fei's supply book remains upstairs; this copy bears her signature and the observed page edges. Anyone disputing the copying can examine the original with her. The Moth's observation has its own stated limits. My seal records this custody arrangement rather than enlarging anyone's permission.

city_perfumer_bounded_claim.speaker: fei_nuo
city_perfumer_bounded_claim.text: The submitted fragments behave like my amber-violet return wax within this comparison. My supply book records that blend for the exchange return desk after the fitting dates on the offered tags. It says where I sent the jar; it does not tell me whose hand later heated it. Compare the courier's dispatch record, Qiao's retained studio papers, and the registry's original rental terms before deciding what happened. I will answer for the formula and these observations. Half the control stock remains upstairs for a repeat test.

city_perfumer_handoff.speaker: narrator
city_perfumer_handoff.text: Fei lowered her shutters after posting a date for ordinary lining repairs. Above the market, the Glasswing Moth reclaimed its dry bay and returned to the waiting cocoons. Lin Yue carried the covered exhibits toward the hearing room, with the cleaning estimate tucked beside the washer's request. The clerk had reserved places for the studio and registry reports, including the courier's separately offered dispatch record. Their papers would have to establish what the batch authorized. The perfumer's comparison could make its material source visible, one limited piece among the findings.

star_terms.speaker: narrator
star_terms.text: Yun opened the source conduit's manual escape gate and showed the star the three support plans. This emergency exit worked independently of any covenant they might later repair. The star answered through the speaking tube: 'I accept a smaller load only while I can stop and leave. I accept an interval outside if your anchors carry it. I also accept departing while you land the mountain safely.' Qing repeated each condition. The star confirmed them before Yue chose an operator's task.

harbor_review.speaker: narrator
harbor_review.text: On the eighth day, before the last interim watch ended, Su Lan convened the promised review. Luo Fen's question settled no future shift. The boat association approved twenty copper from its berth-safety dues for the next eight nights. Existing morning inspections stayed on their ordinary account; this grant would pay only new night checks and an emergency-move reserve. The clerk credited unused earlier offers before recording the grant, so no completed watch was billed twice. Crews offered the named future turns individually.

harbor_review_terms.speaker: su_lan
harbor_review_terms.text: Sixteen copper pays eight night checks at two each; four stays for an emergency move. The crews and Eel accept that scope, with another review before the last check on Day Sixteen. Unused reserve returns. If access changes, we report and request a different berth before the paid term ends. Completed or expired watches create no unpaid replacement shift. Closed-echo protection and the permitted safe stop remain separate from this timed service. I will retain the receiving address and send each accepted worker a copy.
